I am farming 2.59 hectares of maize here in the North East, and this land is rented so I must be careful with what I spend. The rains here in the Sudan Savanna are short and uncertain, so I cannot risk too much money on fertilizer, but a little NPK and urea at planting and top-dressing will help the maize give something back. I will use the improved seed I bought from the agro-dealer last year because local maize does not do well with our short rains, but I have no money for pesticide or irrigation — I will weed with my family and hire a few young men for the ridging and harvest.
